Hi Alice / Falken procurement team,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to begin the vendor activation for Falken so Finance can route the initial PO and enable invoicing. To keep things moving, can you please provide the following by end of week: 

- Completed vendor intake form (we attached our template to this thread) — required for tax and remittance details.
- Executed DPA or confirmation you will sign our standard DPA via DocuSign.
- SOC 2 report or a public SOC 2 summary link and date of last audit.
- Current subprocessor list (names + regions) and any data residency constraints.
- Preferred invoice recipient and billing email for PO generation.

If you already have PDF copies of the SOC 2 and DPA, please attach them; otherwise we can push the DocuSign envelope for signature. Once we receive the intake form and the DPA, Marissa will create the PO in our system and route to Finance.

Attachment: Falken_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf (fillable)

Thanks,
